description: G1 ground MVP static occupy/status scenario. The platoon starts inside the objective zone and validates Army/ground TASK_OCCUPY common-core semantics through ScenarioLoader and TaskOrder -> LeaderIntent -> PilotReport status propagation. The single entity intentionally uses the current runtime-compatible Aircraft spawn shell; ground ownership is expressed through tasking_profile, service_profile, task IDs, and relationship fields.
